name: msdmanuals.com
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 24 form controls have no label.
lesson: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.
summary: www.msdmanuals.com scores 52 out of 100 (F). 12 checks fail now, 21 are at risk, and 32 pass. Fix first: 24 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 24 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /professional, /home, /professional/resourcespages/global-medical-knowledge, /professional/resourcespages/about-the-msd-manuals and 14 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: OneTrust was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Ads (2 requests), and cookies __cf_bm on sitecorecloud.io.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Elements must only use supported ARIA attributes
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 2 elements on /professional, for example div[aria-label="Overview of Hydration video"] and .FeaturedMediaWidget_IFrameComponentContainer__VOcW4 > div[data-testid="ThumbnailClick"] > .Thumbnail_Thumbnail__xTWWY.u. Impact: critical.

fix.title: 1 internal link leads to an error
fix.fix: Fix or remove each link, or redirect the old address with a 301 to the closest live page.

fix.title: Tracking continues after Reject
fix.evidence: After pressing "Reject Cookies" and reloading, Google Ads (2 requests) still appeared.
fix.fix: Map every tag in the consent tool to a category and block it until that category is accepted.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 19 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 380 ms
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Language alternates point at each other
